name: mem20-fleet-build
description: Build unified control plane, first-class CLIs, sales site, DNS/email cleanup, marketing command center, docs wiki, and Websites manager across all 24 subsystems + mem20.

phases.name: Step 2: First-class CLIs (fs-<sub> + fs dispatcher + coverage harness + --json)
phases.notes: DONE (2026-09-25): direct on-disk audit -> 29 installed binaries, 27 declared, 2 installed-but-undeclared (mem20-mcp, mem20-metrics), 0 declared-but-missing. Built mem20ops/clicheck.py + `fs-ops cli-coverage` (read-only, bounded, exits 3 on gaps; naming is INFO ONLY, not a contract). Built `fs` umbrella dispatcher (mem20ops/fleet.py; loose name resolution, child exit codes propagate, exit 2 on bad option). Built mem20cliz (json_main decorator, envelope schema mem20.cli/1) and applied --json to 20 CLIs with 2 lines each, no internals touched; all 20 verified --help + valid envelope; mem20corez human output proven byte-identical. Suite: mem20cliz 21, mem20ops 71, estate 57 pass, lint clean. DECISIONS (Jayson 2026-09-25): NO subsystem renames at all - fs-* and mem20* names are both correct, no exception list; mem20-metrics left alone (install counter, excluded from audit); --json must be purely additive. BUGS FOUND IN OWN WORK AND FIXED: multi-line-import break in mem20secretz; zero-arg main() TypeError; zero-arg main() reading sys.argv directly; editable-install namespace-package shadow that made a silent except-ImportError fallback hide a total no-op (fixed with compat-mode static .pth + loud fallback in all 19 files). PRE-EXISTING, NOT MINE: mem20ucgz + mem20senzen test suites fail on ModuleNotFoundError (mem20ucgz proven pre-existing by restoring original cli.py); mem20senzen directory flaps in/out of existence - handed to another agent, do not touch. REMAINING: byte-diff human output for the 19 CLIs not yet diffed (only mem20corez proven); mem20mktz needs --json but lives in its own venv.

phases.name: Step 1+7: Unified control plane (FastAPI+Vite/React tabs+nav) + Websites manager (deploy/DNS/health)
phases.notes: mem20controlz built and live as systemd unit mem20controlz.service on 127.0.0.1:8890 (PPID=1, enabled, Restart=on-failure, survives restart). FastAPI serves the API and the built Vite/React SPA from one origin. Four tabs: Overview, Subsystems, CLI coverage, Websites (sites/DNS/health/logs/Pages). REST-first with standardised CLI fallback; status is honest - ok/degraded/unreachable/no-health/unknown, never ok without a verified surface, and a missing unit is reported not-found rather than inactive. Auth is Cloudflare Access OR an HMAC admin session, failing closed; secrets live in /opt/mem20/secrets/.env. Full sweep is cached (keyed on probe timeouts) and refreshed in the background: /api/registry went from ~9s cold to ~15ms warm. 102 controlz tests, 71 mem20ops, 21 mem20cliz, 21 toolchest; ruff clean. Registered in toolchest. REMAINING: Cloudflare Access application + tunnel route for control.jaysonai.online, DNS record for it, and moving the unit behind Access trust (CONTROL_TRUST_CF_ACCESS=1) once the tunnel is in place. FOLLOW-UP (2026-09-25): clicheck.audit now probes CLI help concurrently (AUDIT_WORKERS=12) instead of serially - 24s serial sum became ~15s bounded by the slowest probe; /api/cli/coverage is now cached for 10 minutes and refreshed in the background, so it is 12-16ms warm and cannot be killed by a tunnel request timeout. runtime.service_status gained scope support (user=True) and reports load_state/exists from systemd, so a missing unit is named missing instead of reading as a failed service. The Websites health panel is scope-aware and monitors 5 real units including the user units mem20cviz and mem20ucgz; the unit file passes XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS so the service can actually reach the per-user manager. Correction of record: mem20cviz and mem20ucgz were wrongly reported as unsupervised bare processes - they are healthy enabled user units. OPEN DEFECT (not fixed, needs a decision): mem20-mcp --help takes ~13s because it starts the server and fails to bind :8080 (already owned by mcp-server.service) before printing help; --help should be fast and side-effect free. 106 controlz, 73 mem20ops, 21 mem20cliz, 21 toolchest tests pass; ruff clean. EXPOSED (2026-09-25): Cloudflare tunnel mem20-control created and running as cloudflared-mem20-control.service (PPID=1, enabled, Restart=on-failure, token in /etc/cloudflared/mem20-control.token mode 0600, 404 catch-all ingress). DNS CNAMEs written for control.jaysonai.online and shop.jaysonai.online, proxied to the tunnel. Both verified live over the public route. Interim posture chosen by the owner: single admin password only, knowingly, even though the Websites manager can create and delete records in the production zone. BLOCKED: Cloudflare Access cannot be created via API - account 720eb3c...42af returns 403 access.api.error.not_enabled, and this is account state rather than a credential fault (a bogus token returns 400 Authentication failed, while both real API tokens return the 403 and read /zones with 200). Access must be enabled in the Cloudflare dashboard; the Access apps, allowlist policy and CONTROL_TRUST_CF_ACCESS=1 follow from there. Also noted: both Global API Key credentials fail authentication (400) and need rotating; the two API tokens are healthy.

Step 6: Docs wiki (MkDocs Material, public+private split, CF Access)
Step 3: Sales site (Stripe Checkout live, 5 SKU categories, auto-provision)
phases.notes: mem20shopz built and live as systemd unit mem20shopz.service on 127.0.0.1:8891 (enabled, PPID=1, Restart=on-failure, survives restart). Storefront + API from one origin. Five catalog groups, 15 SKUs, one-time and subscription, USD. Stripe Checkout sessions created server-side so the secret key never reaches the browser. Webhook verification uses the Stripe SDK construct_event (constant-time, 300s tolerance) and parses the verified bytes afterwards, so there is no gap between what was checked and what is acted on. Event ids are claimed in SQLite BEFORE provisioning, so a redelivery - including one after a restart - is refused rather than creating a second account for one payment. Fails closed everywhere: no secret key means no checkout, no webhook secret means every event is rejected, and a SKU missing either a Stripe Price or an amount is unsellable. STRIPE_MODE may narrow the mode but cannot promote a test key to live. Provisioning defaults to dry-run and provisions nothing. 42 shopz tests; ruff clean. Verified end to end with real SDK-generated signatures: valid 200/provisioned, replay refused, tampered body 400, stale replay 400, handler invoked exactly once. BLOCKED ON OWNER INPUT (deliberately not guessed): Stripe keys (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in /opt/mem20/secrets/.env), the real catalog SKUs and prices, and what auto-provisioning should actually provision. Nothing is charged and no DNS has been written. Test mode first, then flip to live.
